resources.string: UV forecasts and sunrise/sunset times are provided by Open-Meteo.
Place names are looked up using Nominatim, based on OpenStreetMap data.
UVApp formats and groups forecasts for display and uses UV values to calculate exposure estimates. These estimates are calculated by UVApp, not supplied by the data providers.
SPF is recorded for reference only. It is not used in the exposure countdown and does not extend the estimated exposure time.
Exposure time is an estimate based on UV, skin type and detected surroundings. It does not guarantee a safe time in the sun.
Sound level and camera brightness help classify your surroundings. Microphone and camera sampling runs only while the app is visible. Audio recordings, photos and videos are not saved.
